testInfo.description: OID4VP verifier/RP conformance test for SIROS VC verifier
testInfo.summary:
Tests that the verifier correctly handles a wallet that uses HTTP POST to fetch the request_uri as specified in OID4VP section 5.10. If the verifier's authorization request does not include request_uri_method=post, this test will be skipped.

A screenshot showing the successful verification must be uploaded; the test finishes as REVIEW.
